notes.title: Preaction System Update
notes.content:
Courses for Preaction Systems using the F1 and VXD valves are now available! Learn how to place the different systems into service after installation, how they function during system activation, and the steps to take when resetting the tripped systems.

Startup, Simulation, and Reset courses have been added for the following systems:

 Viking VXD Double-Interlock Electric/Pneu-Lectric Preaction System
 Viking VXD Double-Interlock Electric/Pneumatic Preaction System
 Viking F-1 Double-Interlock Electric/Pneumatic Preaction System
 Viking F-1 Double-Interlock Electric/Pneu-Lectric Preaction System
 Viking VXD Single-Interlock Pneumatic Preaction System
 Viking VXD Single-Interlock Electric Preaction System
 Viking F1 Single-Interlock Electric Preaction System
 Viking F1 Single-Interlock Pneumatic Preaction System
